newsitem.title: UK: LME daily stock reporting to continue indefinitely.
newsitem.headline: LME daily stock reporting to continue indefinitely.

text.p: The London Metal Exchange (LME) said on Thursday that daily reporting of stocks, introduced as a trial in April, will continue indefinitely.

"The daily reporting of LME warranted stocks, which was introduced with effect from April 7 1997 for an initial six months trial period, will continue in operation indefinitely," the LME said in a notice following Wednesday's Board meeting.
The LME is also making further changes to stock transparency, following up the review of the market by the UK regulator, the Securities and Investments Board (SIB).

From October 1, stocks of formerly warranted metal held in LME warehouses pending movement out of the facility will be reported separately as part of the daily stock reporting process, the LME said. --London Newsroom 44 171 542 8080
